metaDescription: CPT 99489 explained: the add-on to complex CCM for each additional 30 minutes of clinical staff time. Pairing rules, documentation and 2026 rate.
summary: An add-on reported with 99487 for each additional 30 minutes of clinical staff time beyond the first 60 in a month.
time: Each additional 30 minutes beyond the first 60
performer: Clinical staff under the billing practitioner's direction
requirements: 99487 supported for the same patient and month
Time log showing minutes beyond the first 60, in 30-minute blocks
Care plan and consent documentation already supporting 99487
pitfalls: Rounding up to a full 30-minute block that was not reached

faqs.question: Is 99489 billed per 20 minutes like 99439?
faqs.answer: No. 99489 counts in 30-minute blocks beyond the first 60 minutes, and only with 99487.

faqs.question: Can I bill 99489 on a month with 99490?
faqs.answer: No. 99489 only attaches to 99487. A month billed with the base code uses 99439 for extra time instead.
